scope: Source-qualified buffered GTIM PWM routes; no hardware validation.

normalization.basis: Own manual register-list base addresses and exact own CMSIS GTIM instances; no sibling inheritance.

electrical_limits.output_conditions: VDD = 3.3 V; own-family Table 7-4 general operating conditions apply.
electrical_limits.ac_basis: Vendor design/simulation data, not measured; maximum-frequency definition requires (tr + tf) <= 2T/3 and 45-55% duty at CL. These are conditional pad limits, not a HAL PWM-rate guarantee.
restrictions: Respect total VDD/VSS current including MCU consumption and absolute-maximum ratings.
Use digital output mode and select the exact AF; no oscillator/debug/reset ownership is changed.
Board load, voltage, signal integrity and PWM behavior require hardware validation.
